body: Miss B's Coconut Club combines an open-air teal bar, tropical dining room and outdoor patio with pink fringed umbrellas in one Mission Beach venue at 3704 Mission Blvd.
Choose a reserved section, private dining configuration or full venue buyout. Food, cocktail packages, room setup and staffing can be planned around your event and guest count.

inquiry.heading: Private Event Inquiry
inquiry.body: Tell us your date, approximate headcount and event type. Our team will follow up with availability and options for your group.
